units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 78:9">Targ. Ps. LXXVIII, 9</cite> <cite ref="M01734"><he>מנו</he></cite> (<cite ref="L00000"><he>ל</he></cite>)<he>קיצא</he> (ed. Lag. <he>מיני</he>, corr. acc.) they calculated the term (of redemption).

<cite ref="Menachot 66a:16">Ib.</cite> <he>רבנן … מְנוֹ יוֹמֵי וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="M01772"><he>מני</he></cite>) the scholars of … counted the days but not the weeks.

<cite ref="Chullin 60b:3">Ḥull. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>לִימְנוּ בך וכ׳</he> the Israelites shall count days and years after thee (the moon); a. fr.—[<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 337">Yalk. Is. 337</cite> <he>דמניין</he>, v. <cite ref="M00395"><he>מוּג</he></cite>.]

<cite ref="Yoma 2a:8">Ib.</cite> <he>ומַנּוּנֵיה</he> and they ordained him.
Sot. 40ᵃ אִימְּנוּ רבנן עליה לממנייה ברישא the scholars agreed to appoint him first; a. fr.—Part. pass. מְמַנָּא, מְמַנִּי; pl. מְמַנָּן appointed; officer (v. מְמוּנֶּה).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 2:5">Targ. Y. Num. II, 5</cite>.

senses.gloss: to register, enter, designate for a share.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 89a:18">Pes. 89ᵃ</cite> <he>דאַמְנִינְהוּ מעיקרא</he> that he had originally designated them for participation in the Passover meal; a. e.

senses.gloss: to take a vote. Ib. 52ᵃ מַמְנוּ Ms. M. (ed. ממינן, read מַמְנִין), v. נִגְדָּא II.

units: <cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 2:33">Targ. Num. II, 33</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Sotah 40a:7">Sot. 40ᵃ</cite>, v. supra.
<cite ref="Gittin 56b">Gitt. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>ואִימְּנוּ להו חשיבי וכ׳</he> (not <he>ואמינא … חשיבא</he>) the nobles of Rome have agreed to place thee at the head; a. e.

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 110:4">Targ. Ps. CX, 4</cite>; <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 110:6">6</cite>; a. fr.—Y. Bicc. l. c. <he>חד מן אילין דמיתמני בכסף</he> (read: <he>דמִיתְמַנִּין</he>) one of those ordained for money’s sake.
<cite ref="Yoma 2a:8">Ib.</cite> (adapting <cite ref="Habakkuk 2:19">Hab. II, 19</cite>) <he>לא בכספייא אי׳ וכ׳</he> has he not been ordained for money? &c.
<cite ref="Habakkuk 2:19">Ib.</cite> <he>לא קבל עלוי מִתְמַנֵּי</he> he would not allow himself to be ordained; a. fr.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 12:4">Targ. O. Ex. XII, 4</cite>.—

<cite ref="Pesachim 89a">Pes. 89ᵃ</cite> <he>ונִימְּנִינְהוּ בהדי כל חד וחד</he> Ms. M. (Ms. O. <he>ונִימְּנֵי כל חד וחד בהדיה</he>; ed. <he>ונימני עילויה הני וכ׳</he>, read <he>עילוי דהני</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) and let them be designated as participants with each of them (and let each of them be designated &c.).

<cite ref="Pesachim 89a:18">Ib.</cite> <he>בתר דשחיט מי קא מתמני</he> after the lamb is slaughtered how can he be entered? <cite ref="Pesachim 60b:10">Ib. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>ומִימְּנוּ עילויה אחריני</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 200) and other persons will be entered for a share in it; a. e.
